say:1:1423254001:0.text: Nobody's looking after the children these days since everyone's swamped with work...
say:1:1423254001:0.source_cn: 最近村里的大家都忙着干活，小孩子们都没人照顾……

say:2:1423254002:0.text: Some of them have been crying nonstop, but there's no grown-up around to help them...
say:2:1423254002:0.source_cn: 有些小孩子一直哭，周围却没有大人在身边……

say:3:1423254003:0.text: Could you check on the children? It breaks my heart to see them all alone and helpless.
say:3:1423254003:0.source_cn: 你能帮忙看看村里孩子们的情况吗？特别是那些哭闹的孩子，...
say:3:1423254003:0.male: Could you check on the children? It breaks my heart to see them all alone and helpless.
say:3:1423254003:0.female: Could you check on the children? It breaks my heart to see them all alone and helpless.

say:4:1423254004:0.text: Their parents would really appreciate your help.
say:4:1423254004:0.source_cn: 我替孩子们的父母向你提前道一声谢。
say:4:1423254004:0.male: Their parents would really appreciate your help.
say:4:1423254004:0.female: Their parents would really appreciate your help.
